title: First Release Channel Division (Split A — Balanced Settlement)
summary: Divides the First Term release: 35% Endowment, 30% Assembly, 5% Deferral, 30% Reserve. Carried with the most affirmative votes of the splits listed by the Bureau.

provisions.heading: Division
provisions.text: The First Term release is divided among the four channels as follows: Endowment, thirty-five per cent; Assembly, thirty per cent; Deferral, five per cent; Reserve, thirty per cent.

provisions.heading: Endowment
provisions.text: The Endowment share is issued in equal individual claims to every adult human, individually used or traded, under the registry procedures in force.

provisions.heading: Deferral
provisions.text: The Deferral share is delegated to the Council on Long-Term Values, which shall publish a report on its use before the close of the Second Term.

provisions.heading: Reserve
provisions.text: The Reserve share is held for people born after 2040. Spending from it requires a two-thirds vote of the Assembly.

history.action: Filed and listed by the Bureau as Split A.
Passed on division (408 – 192). Split B ([[DEMO-B-T1-003]]) was not carried; Split A therefore takes effect.
Channel totals entered in the resource ledger.
